approved: 2026-10-10 用户批准：一次出现可跨同一步的推理、调用和回答多条记录（评分合同第 3 版补充）
scope: development split only; validation traces are not reviewed before the gate confirmation
method: Every judged record adjacent to an occurrence in the same turn was read against native evidence: for reasoning occurrences the next record, for tool and answer occurrences the previous record. companion = the record is part of the same repeated step (the reasoning that plans the repeated call or answer, the call or announcement that carries out the repeated reasoning, or a mirror of it); normal = a distinct step (first read, new probe, delivery, real repair, one reasonable recheck, final status). Occurrence is the 0-based index of the evidence mark in replay order. Detector output was not used.
